scope: Read-only hosted postprocessing of two existing rejected nominal captures; no CAD invocation, new simulation, geometry change, gate change or acceptance.

read_streamed_wave.interpretation: The function is copied byte-exact into the new reader; no original module is executed locally. Its exact strict header/real-float64/full-row validation remains intact.

frozen_derivation.numeric_scope: No acceptance predicates are replaced. Five-device min-activeVCE/max-alltimeabsVCE/max-alltimeabsVBE/max-alltimeabsIc-per-emitter values must exactly replay authentic scalar report values. Contact spreads are observations, not proof of segment-level causality or complete KCL.

measurement_contract.tie_policy: Every exactly tied extremum row is retained. First tie gets the detailed full headroom witness; all ties receive +/-2 original adjacent rows and the predeclared +/-0.5UI native-row window.
first_witness_fields: all selected terminal voltages and Ic/Ids

transport_and_safety.live_binding: Exact original source/run/attempt/workflow/branch and actual failed case job plus its full step sequence, including successful preservation steps. Every one of12 release assets binds ID/bytes/SHA256/state, plus immutable tag target. Other matrix jobs and overall run status are not reclassified as successful.
transport_and_safety.parts: All5 exact ordered parts and combined bytes/SHA256 verified; downloaded parts deleted only after append into the same owned runner archive.
transport_and_safety.archive: Every regular member is hashed against complete6765 output map. Root namespace, unexpected/missing/duplicate/traversal/link/special/sparse members fail. Only actual wave+native-result+composition retained in temporary runner-owned sibling directory, never repository output.
transport_and_safety.limits: Each member <=8GiB and total uncompressed <=16GiB; before download require combined compressed bytes + rawwavebytes +2GiB free on the same filesystem as owned temporary directory. These are transport refusal bounds, not electrical tolerances.
transport_and_safety.source_preservation: All original source/method/report bytes unchanged; current reader source and checker must additionally be pinned by the future source-only workflow/admission. Recheck all exact source/input pins immediately before numeric helper import after transport, then again before the final success record.
transport_and_safety.failure: run() saves failure JSON and always emits all available derived output. Primary errors survive cleanup/save/emission failures. Existing output refuses overwrite. Owned temporary copies are cleaned; original permanent capture releases are untouched.
transport_and_safety.publication: Reader has no upload/release mutation operation. It emits complete indexed per-file zlib/base64 chunks and leaves complete derived outputs for artifact/permanent publication by the root workflow. Zero bytes remain byte-exact in artifact/chunk evidence.
transport_and_safety.full_input_census: complete-input-census.json records every member name, exact bytes and SHA256 after full verification. No native archive or waveform payload is included in derived outputs.

CLI.context: GITHUB_ACTIONS=true, workflow_dispatch, exact branch, attempt1, repository and checkout SHA. Runtime must install NumPy2.3.3; reader imports only stdlib until after reservation/acquisition. Source checker needs NumPy for synthetic controls.
CLI.chunk_decoding: For each name, require sequential index0..N-1 and terminal chunksN; concatenate decoded base64 bytes, zlib-decompress, and compare final exact bytes/SHA256 against both END and INDEX. The full artifact is an independent preservation path.

authored_control_scope: Actual source_guard on complete protected projection and changed/missing inputs; authentic early/late metadata and failed-live producer binding.
